A.method: Spatially stable region structure graph; T1 coordinate reference; point-level precision and regional stability evaluated separately
A.rendering: Original-canvas outline figure uses original RGB without elastic deformation or colour correction; separate crops use a single GLOBAL similarity resampling on T1 scale.
A.validation_limits: Missing periods are not synthesized. If no eligible extra structural route exists, this is explicitly a region candidate for manual review, not accepted continuously registered points. Automatic spatial CV conditional on selected descriptor-consensus anchors, not human landmarks. Pose-fold stability quantifies sensitivity to blocks of selected anchors, not absolute accuracy. Independent route disagreements remain recorded and require visual review; no exact point-registration success is inferred. New roots and changed soil remain in the crop. Upsampling/DPI does not create captured detail.

additional_neural_region_checks.interpretation: Additional neural whole-region model comparison, not independent ground truth or manual accuracy. Candidate confidence may support a repeated-structure alias; no automatic pass inferred.

A.candidate_bridge_interpretation: When requested, a graph-disconnecting edge with descriptor consensus but failed pose-fold stability can only make an explicitly labelled review candidate, never a validated region or point-registration success.

region_anchor_selection.interpretation: All fits restricted to the actual common band plus 20 analysis pixels; validation is conditional on the proposed location. Other whole-frame regions cannot dominate this regional pose.

limitations: Area is geometric observation, including explicitly labelled candidates; not confident root/point support. All descriptor cross-validation and location fits are conditional on full-frame and region hypotheses, not independent manual TRE. All route disagreements are retained. White separators omit unobserved T1 gaps and cannot establish root continuity. No device-period mechanism, root identities, new-root/death labels, colour correction, elastic deformation, or invented detail is asserted.
